trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of sim:knot-periodic-table (two descriptive paragraphs plus a six-item view list). No constructions from the ten categories. VERIFIED the classification sentence: T(2,n) has gcd(2,n) components, so odd n gives a one-component knot and even n a two-component link - 'fermions are single-component odd-n torus knots, bosons are even-n 2-component links' is correct as stated. Also note with approval that this block writes the trefoil correctly as 'closure of sigma_1^3 in B_2', the 2-strand word.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: NOT A TRAP, reported separately, three items. (1) That correct B_2 trefoil word is the direct counterexample to the knot-operations appendix, which writes T(2,3) as the 3-strand sigma_0 sigma_1 sigma_0 - the two chapters disagree. (2) The classification is said to classify 'all entries', but protons and neutrons are given as 3-component Borromean links while being fermions, which the single-component rule excludes. (3) The .md cites def:confined-particle, prop:fermion-boson-knot-link and rem:building-block-knots, none of which appear in the .ts uses[] (which lists prop:shell-structure-eigenvalues and prop:knot-particle-correspondence). Minor pin note: every view in the .ts pins q = 1.11, which is a 3-digit truncation matching no documented pin; defensible as a slider default, worth saying so.
